manual_runtime_test_caveat: The recorded starter and reference outcomes cover this Pack's own behavioral contracts. The upstream project's full test suite was not run and is not claimed by this receipt.

rejected_candidates.detail: Redis Sentinel ACL support; the redis client is not installed in the evaluator runtime and SentinelBackend cannot be constructed without it.
Redis pub/sub get_connection signature change; requires the redis client.
Django fixup pool closing; DjangoWorkerFixup imports django.db at construction time and django is not installed in the evaluator runtime.
Django connection iteration; same dependency as pr_10020.
Django prefork detection; same dependency as pr_10020.
DjangoWorkerFixup recursion fix; same dependency as pr_10020. The pool_cls string hardening from the follow-up pr_10048 is covered instead.
Sphinx :task: cross-reference role; sphinx is not installed in the evaluator runtime and celery.contrib.sphinx cannot be imported.

solar dusk_astronomical horizon sign; celery.schedules.solar imports ephem in its constructor and ephem is not installed. The only alternative would be to assert on the private _horizons table, which is an implementation check.
date_done column defaults as callables; the model module imports sqlalchemy.
date_done index; the model module imports sqlalchemy.
NullPool kwarg filtering; celery.backends.database.session imports sqlalchemy.
asynpool _sentinel_poll guard; AsynPool is POSIX-only and celery's own suite skips these tests on win32, so the contract would fail on reference too.
AsynPool.flush rework needs a live prefork pool. The asynloop half of the same PR is covered by issue_event_loop_hub_teardown.
PEP 649 deferred annotations only differ on Python 3.14+; the evaluator runtime is 3.12 so starter and reference behave identically.

fun_accepts_kwargs via co_flags; same Python 3.14-only motivation. The only observable 3.12 difference is for functools.wraps wrappers, which is an accidental side effect rather than the required behaviour.
RPC result-consumer reconnect discriminates, but only reachable by substituting the consumer's private _connection/_consumer attributes, which would bind the contract to the current class layout.
reconnect_on_error extraction into BaseResultConsumer is a refactor of pr_10179 with the same reachability problem.
Docstring and reference-doc wording for the on_after_finalize signal; no runtime behaviour changes.
Missing space in an s3 backend error message; a contract would assert the exact wording, which is an implementation check, and boto3 is not installed.
